events.summary: Thrun discovers an infant in the jungle, names her Melira, and learns her ability may be key to the plane's survival.
events.quote: he discovered an infant in the jungle whom he later called Melira

events.summary: Thrun helps Kaya Cassir and Elspeth Tirel reach the Furnace Layer.
events.quote: He helped Kaya Cassir and Elspeth Tirel reach the Furnace Layer

events.summary: At the end of the New Phyrexian Invasion Thrun escapes with surviving Mirrans and settles on Zhalfir.
events.quote: Thrun was one of the surviving Mirrans able to escape and settle on Zhalfir
